msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of a fantasy wargame table with painted miniature knights, ruined stone buildings, dice and a measuring tape from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a box of unpainted grey plastic fantasy knight miniatures on sprues, plain packaging, no logos from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EFECE6) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a set of 24 small miniature paint pots in many colours, no labels from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EFECE6) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a set of seven polyhedral dice in translucent purple from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EFECE6) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, sin referencia, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a sealed box of trading card booster packs in plain packaging, no logos from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EFECE6) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
